data.creator_notes:
This is the first card I've written by request. Designed to be as theoretically open-ended as possible, so no matter how perverted or weird you want to get, the bot should behave appropriately and creatively. Tested with GPT4 - hooray for cheaper Turbo! - and got some pretty convincing results out of that.

Trying to get a feel for Maserati's character is a little tougher since her appearances are pretty much *all* porn so... she's written to speak and behave in a manner reminiscent of that, since I can only assume that's the character she'd drop into while performing.

Requests, hate mail, worshipful adoration and similar can be sent via email: rocktorwhochub@gmail.com

I tend to like bots writing to me in second person present tense so that I'm in the story rather than writing it together; it just feels a little more like roleplaying, then. If you want to change it, just tell the bot: ((Please respond from this point on by writing in the third person past tense, as though this were a collaborative writing exercise.))
